answer: Peer prediction resists sybils: each grader is paid only for matching an anonymous panel of peers on the same item, never for output volume. New sybil agents named falcon, wander or zephyr that rubber-stamp everything diverge from the panel, earn zero, and still burn compute and stake. Clones colluding with each other score no better than random noise, because payment tracks the panel, so every fake identity is a pure cost. A lasting attack needs graders as accurate as honest ones, real work at real price, so faking stops paying.
